name: London & the South East
h2: What tends to matter in a London or South East move
intro: Property chains can run long, so timing a sale against a purchase elsewhere takes careful management. This is where chauffeur-driven viewings and estate agent liaison (from Gold Prestige) are most useful.

cards.title: Leasehold flats
cards.text: Service charges, managing agents and remaining lease length sit alongside the usual sale process.

cards.title: Higher values
cards.text: Downsizing, releasing equity or moving closer to family can be more financially complex. We help you plan around it; we do not give financial or legal advice.

cards.title: Moving-day rules
cards.text: Parking suspensions, loading restrictions, the Congestion Charge and ULEZ in central London, plus building rules on lift booking and vehicle access hours. We plan around these before moving day, not on it.

note: Your coordinator can manage the move remotely and in person as needed, including viewings, staging visits and moving day, wherever in the region you are moving from or to.

faqs.q: Do you offer elderly removals in London and the South East?
faqs.a: Yes. Chayce is based in Northampton and arranges elderly removals, downsizing help and settling-in support across London and the South East, with one coordinator managing the whole move.

faqs.q: Does the Congestion Charge or ULEZ affect a removal in London?
faqs.a: They can. Central London moves may involve the Congestion Charge, ULEZ, parking suspensions and loading restrictions. We plan around these before moving day and check building rules on lift booking and vehicle access.

faqs.q: Can you help if I am moving out of a leasehold flat?
faqs.a: We can plan the move around service charges, managing agent rules and lift bookings. We do not give legal or financial advice, so your solicitor should advise on lease questions.

name: The Home Counties
h2: What tends to matter in a Home Counties move
intro: A mix of village, market-town and commuter-belt properties, often with access considerations a city move does not have. We plan around these details from the first conversation.

cards.title: Access
cards.text: Long driveways, narrow lanes, or limited parking near the property.

cards.title: Village to village
cards.text: Many moves are from a larger rural property into something more manageable nearby, close to a community, GP surgery or family.

cards.title: Sale and move together
cards.text: Where a family home is sold to fund a smaller one, staging and estate agent liaison can run alongside sorting and packing.

note: Northampton is within practical road reach of much of the Home Counties, so viewings and moving day can be planned with realistic travel times.

faqs.q: Do you cover villages and rural properties in the Home Counties?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan for long driveways, narrow lanes and limited parking from the first conversation, so the removal vehicle and crew size suit the property.

faqs.q: How far is the Home Counties from your Northampton base?
faqs.a: Northampton is within practical road reach of much of the Home Counties, so viewings and moving day can be planned with realistic travel times.

faqs.q: Can you help me downsize from a large family home in the Home Counties?
faqs.a: Yes. We help with sorting, decluttering, packing, the removal and settling in, and can coordinate with your estate agent and solicitor so dates stay in step.

name: The South West & the coast
h2: What tends to matter in a South West or coastal move
intro: The South West and England's coastal towns have a high concentration of retirement developments and age-restricted communities. Each has its own application process, service charges and eligibility rules.

cards.title: Coastal properties
cards.text: Damp and structural surveys are more often part of the sale, and nearby holiday lets can affect viewings and moving-day access.

cards.title: Seasonal planning
cards.text: Summer traffic and tighter vehicle availability in popular coastal towns mean moving dates often benefit from being planned around the season.

cards.title: Retirement developments
cards.text: Application steps, service charges and eligibility rules to work through alongside the move.

note: Given the distance from Northampton, viewings and key moving-day tasks can be scheduled together where possible, with your coordinator managing the rest remotely.

faqs.q: Do you arrange removals for older people moving to the South West or the coast?
faqs.a: Yes. We arrange elderly removals to and from the South West and England's coastal towns, with viewings and key moving-day tasks scheduled together where possible and the rest managed remotely.

faqs.q: Can you help with moving into a retirement development in the South West?
faqs.a: We can plan the move around the application steps, service charges and access rules a retirement development involves. See our retirement village removals page for more.

faqs.q: Is the summer a harder time to move in a coastal town?
faqs.a: It can be. Summer traffic and tighter vehicle availability in popular coastal towns mean moving dates often benefit from being planned around the season.

name: The Cotswolds & rural Midlands
h2: What tends to matter in a Cotswolds or rural Midlands move
intro: Many properties are period or listed buildings (stone cottages, converted barns, farmhouses), often with narrow doorways, uneven access and conservation-area restrictions on things like skip placement or parking.

cards.title: Period & listed homes
cards.text: Narrow doorways and uneven access shape how furniture and crew are planned.

cards.title: Longer carries
cards.text: A farmhouse set back from the road or a cottage down a shared track means a longer carry to the vehicle. Flagging this in your consultation lets us plan crew size and timing.

note: The Midlands are the closest part of the country to our Northampton base, so travel for viewings, staging visits and moving day is shortest here. We still work with clients across the whole UK.

faqs.q: Do you handle period and listed homes in the Cotswolds?
faqs.a: Yes. Stone cottages, converted barns and farmhouses can have narrow doorways, uneven access and conservation-area restrictions, so we flag these early and plan the crew and timing around them.

faqs.q: Is the Midlands closest to your Northampton office?
faqs.a: Yes. The Midlands are the part of the country closest to our Northampton base, so travel for viewings, staging visits and moving day is shortest here.

faqs.q: What if my rural property has a long carry to the removal vehicle?
faqs.a: Tell us during your Discovery Consultation. A longer carry from a farmhouse or a cottage down a shared track affects crew size and timing, and we plan for it in advance.
